01 / Steering & Chassis

CAD Work to Date

For our preliminary design review, I modeled a simplified pulley layout in Onshape. Our concept uses a 6 N·m stepper motor and a toothed belt, with a proposed 15-tooth motor pulley driving a 60-tooth pulley on the steering column. The larger pulley trades rotation speed for torque at the column.

I completed the reverse-engineered CAD model of the kart chassis. It gives the team a common reference for bringing each subteam’s parts into the master assembly.

02 / Next Steps

Next Steps

We’re beginning force analysis to understand the loads on the steering system. We’ll use the results to guide the next design decisions as we develop the motor mount and finalize the belt and pulley layout.
